beats: setting: Zoey's cozy garden with sunflowers, daisies, and a tiny pink rabbit hutch; event: Zoey wakes up early and finds a shiny red apple dropped by a bird. She examines it, thinking how sweet it would be to eat all by herself.; temptation: keep the apple all to herself; the right choice: share the apple with her garden friends

setting: the sunny meadow near the brook where butterflies dance; event: Zoey meets her friend, a squirrel named Sam, who is looking sad because he dropped his acorn.; temptation: ignore Sam and hop away; the right choice: give Sam half of her orange carrot to cheer him up

setting: the bustling forest clearing where animals gather; event: Zoey sees a group of birds arguing over a pile of shiny pebbles. She notices one bird, Lila, looking lonely on the sidelines.; temptation: walk away and mind her own business; the right choice: offer Lila some of the pebbles to make her feel included

setting: the quiet shade of the old oak tree with mossy branches; event: Zoey discovers a patch of glowing mushrooms that sparkle softly in the daylight. She wants to keep them all for herself.; temptation: hide the mushrooms and keep them secret; the right choice: share the mushrooms with the fireflies who love light

setting: the babbling brook where fish jump and dragonflies skim the water; event: Zoey finds a beautiful smooth stone that sparkles in the sun. She sees a tiny frog, Freddy, who looks thirsty and tired.; temptation: keep the stone and continue hopping; the right choice: give Freddy the stone to use as a cool resting spot

setting: the colorful butterfly garden filled with purple, yellow, and pink blooms; event: Zoey spots a butterfly named Bella struggling to reach nectar because the flower is too tall. She remembers her own carrot.; temptation: watch Bella struggle and hop away; the right choice: use her carrot as a stepping stone so Bella can drink

setting: the twilight hill where the sky turns pink and orange; event: Zoey sees a family of field mice who have only one small piece of cheese left for dinner. She has extra carrots in her bag.; temptation: keep her carrots and leave them alone; the right choice: share her carrots with the mice so they can all eat together

setting: the warm glow of the moonlit meadow where fireflies twinkle; event: Zoey gathers all her animal friends for a celebration under the stars. Everyone laughs, shares stories, and enjoys the feast together.; temptation: none — the moment is purely joyful; the right choice: feel happy inside because everyone shared and smiled
